name: kb_retribution_paladin
notes: The knowledge base's retribution paladin: a seal before any auto attack, Holy Strike when Holy Might is missing or expiring, Crusader Strike to keep Zeal up, Judgement on cooldown, Hammer of Wrath below 20%, a Crusader Strike filler, Repentance, Consecration at two or more targets. Exorcism's Undead/Demon gate, the Windfury wait and fight-specific rows are listed in kb.unexpressed.

rows.text: Seal of Righteousness (SoC build: Seal of Command) | seal missing and an auto will land within the GCD; never auto-attack without a seal [[d:paladin#1485694401534496800]]

entries.note: the Seal of Command build casts Seal of Command here instead

rows.text: Holy Strike | Zeal 3 stacks and Holy Might <= 6 s or missing; also the opener (no Sunders yet) [[d:paladin#1483566674870534344]] [[d:paladin#1483567863577968650]]
Crusader Strike | Zeal < 3 stacks or expiring within 4 s [[d:paladin#1483566674870534344]]

Judgement (Righteousness/Command, or assigned Crusader/Wisdom) then re-seal | right after an auto lands and no strike is about to come off cooldown [[d:paladin#1485694441124659462]] [[d:paladin#1471558463229526216]]
rows.unexpressed: swing timer not in the conditions

rows.text: Exorcism | target is Undead or Demon
rows.unexpressed: creature type not in the conditions

rows.text: Hammer of Wrath | target < 20% and no strike delayed; optional (low value) [[d:paladin#1441422778774454365]]

Crusader Strike or Holy Strike (whichever hits harder) | keep both Zeal and Holy Might up; CS usually wins vs sundered bosses, HS on unsundered trash; SoC prioritises Holy Might, SoR prioritises Zeal [[d:paladin#1494198526383751270]] [[d:paladin#1482302289338433606]]

entries.note: Crusader Strike usually wins on sundered bosses; which strike hits harder is not a condition

rows.text: Repentance | on cooldown on stun-immune bosses (free damage) [[d:paladin#1438268353134465074]]
Consecration | 2+ targets or spare mana; single target only in high-tier gear [[d:paladin#1492066318159970314]]
Wait ~2 s after a Windfury proc before the next strike/Judgement | Windfury Totem present [[d:paladin#1483022433265913865]]
rows.unexpressed: swing timer not in the conditions

rows.text: single-target loop on the Judgement of Wisdom target; Consecration if mana allows
rows.unexpressed: covered by rotation_single[2-4]: the single-target strikes; Consecration waits for two or more mobs

rows.text: Consecration on cooldown (rank 1 when mana is short)

entries.note: moved ahead of the full-rank Consecration: at low mana the rank-1 cast is the row

rows.text: Trinkets / Juju Flurry / Potion of Quickness | 2-3 GCDs into the fight with Zeal and Vengeance up [[d:paladin#1455493072661250152]] [[d:paladin#1484608557075660910]]
Repentance | 60 s cooldown; free damage on immune bosses, CC on others
rows.unexpressed: covered by rotation_single[7]: the same Repentance entry

rows.text: Divine Shield | survival or threat drop only; halves healing done and taken [[d:paladin#1467173434726547698]]
Zeal / Holy Might upkeep | always; Zeal is 3 x 5% haste stacks for 30 s, Holy Might +20% Strength [[d:paladin#1436340559315734589]] [[d:paladin#1436321352041627648]]
